name: MixEval-Hard
intro: MixEval-Hard是MixEval的升级版，设计更具挑战性，旨在为模型改进提供更大空间。该基准通过混合多种现成评测，桥接真实用户查询与标准答案基准的差距。
build_method: MixEval难度加权, 拒绝采样, 查询分布约束
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 多轮, 动态, 实时
build_method_en: MixEval difficulty weighting, rejection sampling, query-distribution constraint
intro_en: MixEval-Hard is an upgraded version of MixEval, designed to be more challenging and provide greater room for model improvement. This benchmark bridges the gap between real user queries and standard answer benchmarks by combining multiple existing evaluations.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.06565 Sections 3.3-4. MixEval-Hard weights each MixEval item's incorrect-response vector by model accuracies to obtain difficulty ξ, then rejection-samples proportional to exp(λξ). A cluster-distance constraint preserves the wild-query distribution while prioritizing difficulty, yielding 1,000 samples. Dynamic updates and source ground truths are retained; GPT-3.5-Turbo-0125 parses outputs for accuracy and Arena Elo rank correlation is used for meta-evaluation.
